_about: The token tree build_tokens.py turns into tokens.json. care.com declares almost no custom properties (raw/css-vars.json) — its MUI layer paints computed values, so every leaf is a measurement from raw/components-computed.json: the #1e1e1e ink, the deep-green/lime brand ramp (with the #8ae718 press state), Oceanic Grotesk / NaN Druid Sans / Oceanic Text Semibold / Proxima Nova, the capsule CTA radii and the 0.3s motion. The 'dark' set is the deep-green footer panel the light page paints, not a user-selectable theme.

sans.source: computed fontFamily of join-cta default (raw/components-computed.json); @font-face declared in raw/css-vars.json
sans.description: The UI stack: Oceanic Grotesk first — nav, buttons, fields, cards and body copy; Arial and system sans fallbacks.
